kernels.title: Vector tour
kernels.label: NX8 E4
kernels.description: The vector_tour conformance program: loads a mask, two R_CYCLIC slots and R0/R1, then runs MULT.VE, MULT.RC.VV/VS/VE and MULT.EE into ACC.ADD/SUB/MAX, masked multiplies, and a 4-row matrix-vector loop with AGG.SUM.FIRST. NX8 e4 rows: each element is decoded with the QF half in CR14.L and the scale in its row's metadata, multiplied into FP32 MULT_RES and R_ACC, and every result row leaves through ACTIVATE.QUANTIZE (identity, then relu), which quantizes it back to one NX8 row with its own scale.

kernels.title: Vector tour
kernels.label: NX8 E5
kernels.description: The vector_tour conformance program: loads a mask, two R_CYCLIC slots and R0/R1, then runs MULT.VE, MULT.RC.VV/VS/VE and MULT.EE into ACC.ADD/SUB/MAX, masked multiplies, and a 4-row matrix-vector loop with AGG.SUM.FIRST. NX8 e5: wider range and fewer mantissa bits than e4, so each ACTIVATE.QUANTIZE store rounds more coarsely.

kernels.title: Vector tour
kernels.label: NX8 E3
kernels.description: The vector_tour conformance program: loads a mask, two R_CYCLIC slots and R0/R1, then runs MULT.VE, MULT.RC.VV/VS/VE and MULT.EE into ACC.ADD/SUB/MAX, masked multiplies, and a 4-row matrix-vector loop with AGG.SUM.FIRST. NX8 e3: more mantissa bits, narrow range; the row scale in the metadata carries the magnitude.

kernels.title: Vector tour
kernels.label: NX8 dynamic
kernels.description: The vector_tour conformance program: loads a mask, two R_CYCLIC slots and R0/R1, then runs MULT.VE, MULT.RC.VV/VS/VE and MULT.EE into ACC.ADD/SUB/MAX, masked multiplies, and a 4-row matrix-vector loop with AGG.SUM.FIRST. Dynamic NX8: each ACTIVATE.QUANTIZE store picks the exponent width of its row from the data and records it in the row's metadata (dynamic_exponent), which a MULT that later loads the row reads back.

kernels.title: Fully connected
kernels.label: NX8 E4
kernels.description: Dense layer, 10 samples × 128 inputs → 64 outputs on NX8 e4 rows, accumulated in FP32 R_ACC. One word per input element: LR address updates, MULT.RC.VE, ACC.ADD, the next weight-row load and the loop branch; each sample's outputs leave through one ACTIVATE.QUANTIZE store.

kernels.title: Fully connected
kernels.label: NX8 E5
kernels.description: The same dense layer on NX8 e5 rows.

kernels.title: Fully connected
kernels.label: NX8 dynamic
kernels.description: The same dense layer on dynamic NX8 rows: each row's exponent width is in its metadata.

kernels.title: Identity copy
kernels.label: FP32
kernels.description: Copies a 3 × 128 FP32 matrix one XMEM row at a time: MULT.VE by the hardware constant 1.0 (CR1), ACC.ADD.FIRST, then ACTIVATE.EXACT identity, which stores the row.

kernels.title: Channel peak
kernels.label: FP32
kernels.description: Detector confidence over 4 channels × 16 cells: ACC.MAX across channel planes, ACC.SUB of the threshold, ReLU gate and store via ACTIVATE.EXACT.

kernels.title: Row softmax
kernels.label: FP32
kernels.description: Numerically stable softmax over 2 rows: AGG.MAX for the row maximum, the exact exp2 activation (ACTIVATE.EXACT), AGG.SUM for the denominator, MULT.EE to normalise.

kernels.title: Depth to space
kernels.label: FP32
kernels.description: Pixel shuffle, upscale factor 2, 2 × 8 grid. ACC.RESHAPE scatters eight MULT_RES elements per instruction into arbitrary R_ACC slots, indexed by LRD pairs.

kernels.title: 3×3 convolution
kernels.label: FP32
kernels.description: Standard 3×3 conv2d. Three vertically neighbouring 128-element input chunks rotate through the four R_CYCLIC slots; each tap is one MULT.RC.VE (all 128 lanes × one weight) and an ACC.ADD into R_ACC. Edge lanes are masked.

kernels.title: Residual add
kernels.label: FP32
kernels.description: FP32 element-wise add of two 64-channel tensors: MULT.RC.VE by 1.0 copies each chunk, ACC.ADD.FIRST and ACC.ADD sum them, and ACTIVATE.EXACT identity writes R_ACC back.
